text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fierce battle of the Grand Masters 
left a lasting impression on everyone 
watching before coming to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume running today, starting with 
<chrname>, will surely become the pillars 
supporting the Umamusume of tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our three-legged race with <chrname> will continue 
on for much longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of future umamusume— and 
above all, she wished to leave behind the 
hoofprints of their journey even more 
clearly than before.
